annotations.title: Check an MCP server against Default Privacy's vetted list

description: Before connecting an MCP server, check whether it is in Default Privacy's vetted list and what it can read or change. Give its repository URL, server URL, name or slug. A listed server returns its record with sources and caveats. An unlisted one returns a short checklist plus, for a GitHub or registry name, what the publisher declared in the official MCP registry (not a review), and, for an exact registry name or server URL, what Default Privacy's monthly read-only scan saw: whether it needed a sign-in, its tool names and its own read-only/destructive labels. Unlisted is not a verdict, only that we have not reviewed it.

server.description: The server's repository URL, server URL, name or slug, e.g. 'https://github.com/bitwarden/mcp-server'.
